scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.dev:host: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend "npm --prefix frontend run dev:host" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
